title: The Theoriser Shark boy and lava girl deep dive
content: https://youtu.be/ht4tefXuFos?si=hhrl5aWhhSU41Dp4 Recurring dreams, shared extra dimensional dream worlds that mirror and effect the waking world, uninhibited powers, manifestation, the remembering, physic premonition, shadow/mirrored self, dark and light (duality) I was beyond obsessed with this movie as a child and I see the connection. The astral ‘dream’ world - mall world - is a training ground - a remembering of our true power and creator status. The more I see in literature and media and anecdotal experience the more I believe this statement.
